symptom.observable_failure: Single-use promotional coupon BLACKFRIDAY_SINGLE_USE is redeemed twice under concurrent checkout requests, producing two discounted orders for remainingUses = 1

hypotheses.mechanism: TOCTOU read-modify-write race between readCoupon() and unsafeWriteCoupon() allows two concurrent fibers to observe remainingUses = 1 before either decrements the row
hypotheses.prediction: Boundary trace at readCoupon() will show two distinct request correlation IDs reading version = 1 and remainingUses = 1 within the same millisecond window
hypotheses.falsified_if: Second request reads version = 2 or remainingUses = 0 at readCoupon() entry
hypotheses.evidence: In-memory probe recorded req_a and req_b both reading {remainingUses: 1, version: 1} at t+0ms before req_a wrote version 2 at t+4ms

hypotheses.mechanism: Frontend checkout button lacks debounce and replays the same idempotency key while the server returns a uncached non-idempotent response
hypotheses.prediction: Both redemptions will carry identical client session IDs, user IDs, and idempotency headers
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing duplicate redemptions originate from two distinct authenticated user IDs and distinct correlation IDs
hypotheses.evidence: Probe showed the two redemptions belonged to distinct users usr_01 and usr_02 with different idempotency keys

hypotheses.mechanism: Redis read-replica lag serves stale remainingUses = 1 after primary database commit has already completed
hypotheses.prediction: Second request arrives >50ms after first request's write commit and targets the read-only replica pool
hypotheses.falsified_if: Both requests execute against the primary database connection pool and overlap before the first transaction commits
hypotheses.evidence: Probe confirmed both reads hit the primary pool concurrently 3.8ms before the first write completed

discriminating_probe.design: Record in-memory ring-buffer tuple (correlation_id, user_id, pool_role, observed_version, observed_remaining, monotonic_ns) at readCoupon() and writeCoupon() entry/exit
discriminating_probe.observed_outcome: Two distinct users hit primary pool concurrently; both observed version=1, remainingUses=1 before either write completed

binary_search_isolation.initial_fault_space: API Gateway -> CheckoutController -> CouponRedemptionService -> CouponStorePort -> PostgreSQL
binary_search_isolation.isolated_boundary: CouponRedemptionService.redeemCoupon non-atomic read-then-write seam into CouponStorePort

verdict.rationale: Differential diagnosis falsified H2 and H3 via a single read-only probe, determinism pinning reproduced the H1 TOCTOU race 100% of the time via a 2-party rendezvous barrier without sleep(), and atomic CAS passed Red-Green-Revert verification.
revisit_triggers: Contention rate on high-volume multi-use promo codes exceeds 15% CAS retry threshold (requires sharded counter evolution via paranoid-principal-architect)
